EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 3
EPISODE LOGLINE: Theo's fire alarm gets Nadia out of the tower, but the police wait at her mother's door and Selene offers a deal.
CONTINUITY NOTES: Picking up at the Episode 2 cliffhanger: Grant's flashlight finds Nadia's dress behind the rack.
